admin
The Admin console application's activity reports return account information
about different types of administrator activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/reference/activity-ref-appendix-a/admin-event-names).

various Calendar activity events

chat
The Chat activity reports return information about various Chat activity events

drive
The Google Drive application's activity reports return information about various
Google Drive activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/reference/activity-ref-appendix-a/drive-event-names).
The Drive activity report is only available for Google Workspace Business and
Enterprise customers.
gcp
The Google Cloud Platform application's activity reports return information about
various GCP activity events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/gcp).
gmail
The Gmail application's activity reports return information about various Gmail
activity events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/gmail).
gplus
The Google+ application's activity reports return information about various
Google+ activity events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/gplus).
groups
The Google Groups application's activity reports return information about various
Groups activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/reference/activity-ref-appendix-a/groups-event-names).
groups_enterprise
The Enterprise Groups activity reports return information about various
Enterprise group activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/groups-enterprise).
jamboard
The Jamboard activity reports return information about various Jamboard
activity events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/jamboard).
login
The Login application's activity reports return account information about different
types of Login activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/reference/activity-ref-appendix-/login-event-names).
meet
The Meet Audit activity report returns information about different types of Meet

mobile
The Device Audit activity report returns information about different types of

rules

The SAML activity report returns information about different types of SAML

The Token application's activity reports return account information about
different types of Token activity events

user_accounts
The User Accounts application's activity reports return account information about
different types of User Accounts activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/user_accounts).
context_aware_
access
The Context-aware access activity reports return information about users' access
denied events due to Context-aware access rules
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/context-aware-access).
Enums
chrome
The Chrome activity reports return information about Chrome browser and
Chrome OS events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/chrome).
data_studio
The Data Studio activity reports return information about various types of Data
Studio activity events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/data-studio).
keep
The Keep application's activity reports return information about various Google
Keep activity events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/keep). The Keep
activity report is only available for Google Workspace Business and Enterprise
customers.
vault
The Vault activity reports return information about various types of Vault activity
events (/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/vault).
gemini_in_
workspace_apps
The Gemini for Workspace activity reports return information about various types
of Gemini activity events
(/admin-sdk/reports/v1/appendix/activity/gemini-in-workspace-apps)
performed by users within a Workspace application.
classroom
The Classroom activity reports return information about different types of
Classroom activity events
(https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/reports/v1/appendix/activity
/classroom)
.
